item.title: Isometric Sale: Now Live
item.description:
The Isometric Sale has begun!

Today we’re celebrating the games we love — isometric adventures! META Publishing and Owlcat Games have arranged the Isometric Sale, gathering more than 160 games into this one event and offering you special discounts.

Do you love turn-based combat or real-time with pausing? Want to experience a deep story and explore vast worlds? Something is waiting for every kind of RPG fan

From acclaimed classics to exciting discoveries, this is a perfect opportunity to expand your collection and embark on your next unforgettable journey. Discover new games and enjoy the discounts of the Isometric Sale!

The sale will continue till August 19th, so, if your wishlist has been waiting for the right moment, this is it.

🔗Steam Sale Page🔗

Let's take a closer look at some of the special offers available.
Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
The treasures and secrets of the Koronus Expanse await its new Rogue Trader. Take up the mantle of the Lord Captain and shape your story. Will you stay devoted to the Imperial Creed or will you be merciful? Or maybe you’re ready to succumb to heresy?

The choice is yours – grab Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader with a nice 65% discount!


Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous – Enhanced Edition
Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous has a lot to offer to a true RPG lover — deep story, detailed companions, and lots of classes, races and potential builds. Explore nine unique Mythic Paths and lead the Crusade!

It’s time to save Golarion from the all-consuming terror unleashed from the Abyss with 75% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184370/Pathfinder_Wrath_of_the_Righteous__Enhanced_Edition/
Rue Valley
A captivating story-rich adventure game where your character becomes stuck in a strange time loop. Discover the mysteries of Rue Valley with a 50% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126190/Rue_Valley/
Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
Heresy is festering in the Calixis Sector. The ominous Tyrant Star is shining over Scintilla. It is the duty of the Inquisition to investigate what horrors are lurking in the shadows. Become the acolyte and let not heresy slip past you!

Don’t miss the news and the release date — add Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710600/Warhammer_40000_Dark_Heresy/
Shadow of the Road
An upcoming turn-based RPG, Shadow of the Road features a feudal Japan where magic meets machines. If you enjoy games with a distinctive visual style and rich storyline, be sure to add this game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173980/Shadow_of_the_Road/
But that's not all. Stay tuned for more news on our platforms — even more gifts await. The giveaways are on the way! Don't miss your chance to win a key for one of the cool games participating in the Isometric Sale!

Happy adventuring!

item.title: Lords of the End Times - coming September 24th!
item.description:
​

Total Warriors,

The End Times draw near. We’re delighted to announce that Total War: WARHAMMER III Lords Of The End Times will release on September 24th.

A collection of cataclysmic curiosities, this pack represents the biggest DLC that we’ve ever released in the series 10-year history. It unleashes four new Legendary Lords into the vast Immortal Empires campaign, bringing with them a legion of deadly new units and lore inspired features alongside a game-changing free update.

As always, you can choose to purchase all four Legendary Lords as a bundle with a 15% discount or opt to pick & choose each individually. And in a series first, purchasing any of the content grants access to the colossal Immortal Empires campaign with no need to own any of the Total War: WARHAMMER games, making it a great entry point for new players.

The fate of the world will be in your hands; will you save it… or destroy it?

Check out the new trailer below, yes-yes:

— The Total War Team
